Binclusive covers web and mobile accessibility testing. Source scans support JSX/TSX, Astro, Liquid, SwiftUI, UIKit, Interface Builder, Jetpack Compose, Android XML, React Native and Unity scenes.

Live audits use real screen readers: NVDA with Chrome for web, TalkBack on Android, and VoiceOver on iOS simulators and physical devices. Physical iOS and Android devices can also be tested from Windows.

CLI: npm i -g @binclusive/cli. Output formats include pretty, JSON, SARIF 2.1.0 and GitHub annotations.

PDF accessibility: Content Studio evaluates PDF/UA-1 and WCAG requirements, provides automated fixes for document tags, reading order and alternative text, and supports human review where automated checks are insufficient.

Documentation: https://docs.binclusive.io/
features: Binclusive tests accessibility the way people use your product: real screen readers (NVDA, TalkBack, VoiceOver) walk your web and mobile journeys. Automated WCAG 2.2 A/AA checks cover live pages, source code (React, SwiftUI, Jetpack Compose) and PDFs, and block regressions in pull requests. One dashboard, CLI and MCP server track every fix.
